most_similar_reason: Candidate 9 is essentially the same narrative complex: the archetypal first man/progenitor whose name titles successive world-ages, with the seventh warned by a fish-incarnation of a preserver god who instructs him to build a boat loaded with the scriptures, seven sages and his family, then tows it through the deluge to safety.
least_similar_reason: Candidate 5 has no gods, no flood, no fish or rescued ancestor at all, describing instead an agricultural harvest custom of making a straw figure to house a grain spirit.
